title: TidyTron: Reducing lab waste using validated wash-and-reuse protocols for common plasticware in Opentrons OT-2 robots
protocol_category: plasticware wash-and-reuse / tip and plate cleaning
results_evidence: Carryover after wash validated by qPCR/transformation and fluorescence assays showing no detectable cross-contamination vs fresh plasticware.
readiness_reason: Open paper text (CC BY-NC-ND), Apache-2.0 repo with 37 standalone OT-2 API v2 scripts that should simulate as-is; wash/reuse figures give measured outcomes.

title: Enabling high-throughput enzyme discovery and engineering with a low-cost, robot-assisted pipeline
protocol_category: E. coli transformation, inoculation, expression, lysis, enzyme assay
results_evidence: Robot-assisted pipeline screened enzyme variant libraries; activity/expression measured and compared with manual handling.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper plus modular per-step OT-2 v2 scripts; only blocker is the unlicensed repo (cannot vendor, can still reference).

title: Accelerated strain construction and characterization of C. glutamicum protein secretion by laboratory automation
protocol_category: Golden Gate assembly, heat-shock transformation, plasmid prep, plating
results_evidence: Automated strain construction produced verified C. glutamicum secretion strains characterised in microbioreactor cultivations.
readiness_reason: Open paper, one script per protocol step, each self-contained; AGPL-3.0 means reference-only (same constraint as APEX).

title: High-Throughput DNA Extraction Using Robotic Automation (RoboCTAB) for Large-Scale Genotyping
protocol_category: CTAB plant DNA extraction
results_evidence: DNA yield/purity and genotyping call rates from robot-extracted samples compared with manual CTAB extraction.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper; two complete protocols (OT-2 and Flex variants) give a natural easy/hard pair; repo unlicensed.

title: Bacterial Lysis Observation Over Time Assay (BLOTS) for High-Throughput Isolation and Screening
protocol_category: 384-well assay plate assembly / lysis kinetics screening
results_evidence: Assay plates assembled by the robot yielded time-resolved lysis curves used to recover and sequence isolates.
readiness_reason: Current Protocols article is a step-by-step protocol (ideal NL input) with a single matching OT-2 script; licence of code unstated.

title: Performance and automation of ancient DNA capture with RNA hyRAD probes
protocol_category: hybridization capture + magnetic bead washes (magnetic module, thermocycler)
results_evidence: Capture efficiency and on-target read fractions for automated vs manual hybridization reported for ancient DNA libraries.
readiness_reason: Single self-contained module-driven script; good hard task (magnetic module + temperature steps). Paper is ND-licensed so text can be linked not redistributed.

title: MassSpecPreppy - an end-to-end solution for automated protein concentration determination and flexible sample digestion for proteomics
protocol_category: BCA assay, reduction/alkylation, SP3 digestion, Evotip loading
results_evidence: BCA recovery 101.3% (SD 7.8) for the automated workflow vs 96.3% manual; 94.5% of protein groups passed thresholds for OT-2 digestion.
readiness_reason: GPL-3.0 templates, one file per workflow stage, quantitative wet-lab comparison in the paper; templates are parameterised by the Shiny app so some placeholder filling is needed.

title: Semi-automated production of cell-free biosensors
protocol_category: cell-free reaction assembly (384-well biosensor build)
results_evidence: A full 384-well plate of fluoride-sensing cell-free reactions assembled robotically matched expected colorimetric/fluorescent detection performance.
readiness_reason: One script maps to one figure, open preprint text, viscous cell-free liquid class makes it a good hard task; repo unlicensed.

title: An automated platform for tailored late-stage halogenation of pharmaceuticals
protocol_category: reaction array setup, quench, NMR/LC-MS sample prep
results_evidence: Screening arrays dispensed by OT-2 gave halogenation conversions/selectivities measured by NMR and LC-MS across substrate panels.
readiness_reason: BSD-3 code, several independent stage scripts, chemistry (non-bio) diversity for the benchmark; must confirm final journal version.

title: Development of an Automated Workflow for Screening the Assembly and Host-Guest Behavior of Metal-Organic Cages
protocol_category: solution-phase screening array + host-guest assay
results_evidence: Automated screen identified assembled cages confirmed by MS/NMR and host-guest binding measured across the array.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper, five discrete OT-2 scripts; repo carries no licence so reference-only.

title: Streamlining the automated discovery of porous organic cages
protocol_category: cage synthesis plate + analytical transfer protocols
results_evidence: Automated workflow produced porous organic cages characterised by HRMS/NMR, with hit rates reported vs manual discovery.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper and a repo that even ships simulate.py (so scripts are known to run in opentrons_simulate); unlicensed repo.

title: Repurposing amine and carboxylic acid building blocks with an automatable esterification reaction
protocol_category: 96-well library synthesis, quench, solvent/salt screen
results_evidence: 96-well esterification library synthesised on OT-2 with yields/conversions measured by LC-MS.
readiness_reason: MIT code with custom labware JSON included; journal text may be paywalled but the ChemRxiv version is open.

title: Modular automated high-throughput isolation and phylogenetic identification of bacteria from complex communities
protocol_category: microvolume DNA extraction, two-step amplicon PCR, bead purification, pooling
results_evidence: Isolates recovered and phylogenetically identified from automated plates; sequencing success rates reported vs manual pipeline.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper with 11 modular OT-2 scripts, each a clean single-step task; repo has no licence.

title: A linear programming-based strategy to save pipette tips in automated DNA assembly (with DAMP Lab MoClo/transformation workflow)
protocol_category: MoClo Golden Gate assembly + E. coli transformation + plating
results_evidence: Tip-saving assembly strategy evaluated on OT-2 runs; assembly/transformation success measured against standard tip usage.
readiness_reason: BSD-3 templates, open paper; templates are parameterised so labware/volume filling is needed before simulation.

title: The Laboratory Automation Protocol (LAP) Format and Repository: A Platform for Enhancing Workflow Efficiency in Synthetic Biology
protocol_category: library of standardised protocols (colony selection, PCR setup, media distribution, plate merging)
results_evidence: Each LAP entry documents wet-lab execution/validation records on OT-2 at the host biofoundry.
readiness_reason: Large multi-protocol repo (same code base as the existing lap-transposon-genotyping source) with no licence; the LAP format paper itself is new to the corpus and each entry could become a task after per-entry validation.

title: Automated prototyping of genetic codes
protocol_category: in vitro translation reaction assembly, RNA purification
results_evidence: Automated prototyping produced and characterised reassigned genetic codes with mass-spec/translation readouts.
readiness_reason: Repo states Opentrons API 2.13 and has stage scripts, but the paper is ND-licensed and the repo unlicensed; scripts are tied to bespoke labware.

title: Accelerating protein design by scaling experimental characterization
protocol_category: SEC fraction pooling and normalisation for protein characterisation
results_evidence: High-throughput expression/characterisation of designed proteins; thousands of designs assayed with the automated pipeline.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper, MIT single-purpose script (pool and normalise) — a clean medium task.

title: Modular development enables rapid design of media for alternative hosts
protocol_category: combinatorial media blending into microplates
results_evidence: Blended media designs were tested in growth experiments for alternative microbial hosts, with growth rates reported per formulation.
readiness_reason: MIT code with a calibration protocol and plate-prep generator, but the paper text is probably not open, and the protocol is generated from an Excel template.

title: Dynamic cybergenetic control of bacterial co-culture composition via optogenetic feedback
protocol_category: automated sampling from eVOLVER bioreactors into plates
results_evidence: Closed-loop optogenetic control held co-culture ratios at setpoints, measured by cytometry/OD from robot-sampled timepoints.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper and a real sampling protocol, but hardware-coupled (custom needle, eVOLVER) and unlicensed, so simulation needs labware stubs.

title: Accelerating Formulation Design via Machine Learning: Generating a High-throughput Shampoo Formulations Dataset
protocol_category: viscous liquid formulation preparation with gravimetric verification
results_evidence: Gravimetric analysis of robot-prepared formulations and downstream property measurements form the published dataset.
readiness_reason: CC BY data descriptor plus one OT-2 script; viscous-liquid handling parameters make a good hard variant. Repo unlicensed.

title: Cell-type-specific signaling networks in heterocellular organoids (TOBis barcoding / robotic organoid extraction)
protocol_category: mass-cytometry barcode production/aliquoting, organoid extraction
results_evidence: TOBis barcoded organoids profiled by mass cytometry; signalling networks resolved per cell type.
readiness_reason: Seven complete OT-2 protocols, but the paper is subscription-only and the repo has no licence, so paper text must be sourced elsewhere.

title: Opentrons Flex 384-well protein-precipitation sample preparation for nontargeted exposomics
protocol_category: protein precipitation / dilution in 384-well format for LC-HRMS
results_evidence: README reports up to 288 biological samples plus QC per plate feeding multiple LC-HRMS assays, but no peer-reviewed results found.
readiness_reason: MIT Flex protocols with custom labware (rare and valuable), but no paper located yet, so the paper->code triple is incomplete.

title: Automated QIAseq FX DNA Library Preparation on the Opentrons Flex
protocol_category: NGS library preparation (fragmentation, adapter ligation, bead cleanup, PCR)
results_evidence: Protocol entry reports libraries prepared for Illumina short-read sequencing of bee gut samples (sequencing-ready yields).
readiness_reason: A protocols.io DOI with CC BY text is an ideal NL input, GPL-3.0 Flex script matches it one-to-one; Flex coverage is thin in the corpus.

title: An Opentrons OT-2 workflow for the Cayman His-tag detection ELISA kit
protocol_category: ELISA sample/standard loading, plate washing, substrate addition
results_evidence: Standard curves and His-tag quantification generated from the automated ELISA runs in the Arcadia protocol record.
readiness_reason: CC BY protocols.io text, MIT scripts including a hardware test; a clean easy/hard pair (loading vs wash+substrate).

title: An inexpensive semi-automated sample processing pipeline for cell-free RNA (extraction)
open_access_license: preprint CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; journal version subscription
protocol_category: cell-free RNA extraction and cleanup
results_evidence: RNA yields and sequencing library quality from the semi-automated pipeline compared with manual extraction.
readiness_reason: Six numbered OT-2 steps (good task series) but code is unlicensed and the open text is the earlier preprint, not the Nature Protocols version.

title: Automated Discovery of Multicellular Behavior for Optimized Plant Growth and Climate Resilience
protocol_category: plate filling and treatment dosing for plant phenotyping
results_evidence: Automated phenotyping screen measured growth responses used to select stress-resilient conditions.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper and MIT scripts; two scripts give an easy (fill plates) and harder (full protocol) pair.

title: Automated colony picker add-on for the OT-2 (Imperial SSB MRes; cited by Slowpoke)
venue: project report / cited in ACS Synth Biol 2026
protocol_category: colony PCR reagent prep and colony resuspension
results_evidence: Vision-guided colony picking demonstrated on OT-2; results reported only in the project write-up and via the Slowpoke citation.
readiness_reason: Two clean OT-2 scripts closely related to the existing colony-PCR tasks, but no standalone peer-reviewed paper and no licence.

title: Automated yeast spot assay on Opentrons OT-2 (bioinfo-tsukuba)
venue: repository (paper referenced in README, not yet identified)
protocol_category: serial dilution and spotting with plate-reader feedback
results_evidence: README states the workflow executes automatic spot assays with Byonoy absorbance readings feeding the dispensing plan.
readiness_reason: Protocols are generated by compilers rather than being standalone .py, and the paper is unidentified; same lab as the existing pipetting-speed-ot2 source.

title: Opentrons OT-2 biochemical assay scripts (Merck/MSD, Bradford and PicoGreen standard curves)
protocol_category: standard-curve assays (Bradford protein, PicoGreen dsDNA)
results_evidence: Filename and README indicate a validated PicoGreen standard curve run on the OT-2; no published figures located.
readiness_reason: Apache-2.0 and simple enough to simulate immediately, but no linked paper or reported results, so it fails the triple requirement.

title: An automatic end-to-end chemical synthesis development platform powered by large language models
protocol_category: LLM-driven reaction development and robotic execution
results_evidence: End-to-end synthesis campaigns executed with reported yields and optimised conditions.
readiness_reason: Strong paper+code pairing but the robot layer is not Opentrons/PLR, so it is more a comparison system than a task source.

title: An AI-driven workflow for the accelerated optimization of cell-free protein synthesis
code_files: (no Opentrons protocol .py; generates Echo/liquid-handler instruction CSVs)
protocol_category: cell-free reaction composition DoE and instruction generation
results_evidence: Iterative ML rounds improved cell-free protein yields measured on plate reader across generated compositions.
readiness_reason: Open paper and MIT code, but the output is an instruction CSV for an acoustic dispenser, so a task would need a translation layer rather than an Opentrons script.

title: A liquid handling platform for standardized quantification of cell-free enzymatic activity
code_files: (R script generates python for BMS Myra; no Opentrons protocol)
protocol_category: cell-free enzymatic activity assay setup
results_evidence: Standardised enzymatic activity quantification reproducible across operators/platforms reported in the paper.
readiness_reason: CC BY paper with generated-protocol code for a BMS Myra; useful for cross-platform generalisation tasks but not directly simulatable.

title: The Duckbot: A system for automated imaging and manipulation of duckweed
protocol_category: duckweed plate manipulation, media exchange, imaging
results_evidence: Automated growth assays measured duckweed area/growth across treatments.
readiness_reason: Open paper and MIT code, but the Jubilee/science_jubilee API is a third platform; valuable for platform breadth, needs a new runner.

title: High-throughput screening of catalytically active inclusion bodies using laboratory automation and Bayesian optimization
code_files: (analysis-only python: catibts/models.py, catibts/parsing.py; robot methods not in repo)
protocol_category: automated CatIB expression screening with Bayesian optimisation
results_evidence: Screening campaign identified improved CatIB variants with activity measurements across rounds.
readiness_reason: Repo holds analysis code and raw data only; the liquid-handler methods (Tecan/Hamilton) are not published as Python.

title: ProteoAutoNet: high-throughput co-eluted protein analysis with robotics and machine learning
code_files: (11 analysis python files; no liquid-handler protocol script found)
protocol_category: automated proteomics sample handling + ML analysis
results_evidence: Co-elution networks derived from robot-processed samples validated against known complexes.
readiness_reason: Only ML/analysis code is released; no robot protocol code.

title: Automation-Assisted Photoinduced Atom Transfer Radical Polymerization
protocol_category: polymerisation recipe planning for automated dispensing
results_evidence: Polymerisations run from planner recipes characterised by GPC (conversion, dispersity).
readiness_reason: Open paper and MIT code, but the package only computes recipes; the dispensing layer (custom handler) is separate.

title: A user's guide to your first self-driving liquid handling lab
code_files: (GUI/driver python for ACRO + Integra pipette; no Opentrons protocol)
protocol_category: self-driving lab enzyme assay optimisation
results_evidence: Closed-loop campaign optimised enzyme assay conditions with plate-reader readouts.
readiness_reason: Great tutorial-style open text and MIT code, but a bespoke handler API; useful as a non-Opentrons generalisation target.

title: Pipette Show: An Open Source Web Application to Support Pipetting into Microplates
protocol_category: manual pipetting guidance
results_evidence: Error rates for manual plate filling with vs without the app.
readiness_reason: No robot code; manual-pipetting aid only.

title: Open-source cell culture automation system with integrated cell counting for passaging microplate cultures
protocol_category: cell culture passaging / cell counting
results_evidence: Automated passaging maintained cell cultures over weeks with counting accuracy benchmarked against manual counts.
readiness_reason: Already in the corpus as opencell-automation, but this second BSD-3 repo (protocol framework, calibration scripts, simulation proxy) was not ingested and could yield runnable tasks.

title: Moeller Lab Opentrons protocol library (Zymo magbead extraction, Hackflex, Quantifluor)
protocol_category: magnetic-bead DNA extraction, Hackflex library prep, DNA quantification
results_evidence: Hackflex libraries and extractions benchmarked by sequencing yield/quality in the companion paper.
readiness_reason: MIT library with nine OT-2 scripts beyond the Hackflex one already tracked; extraction and quantification protocols are new task material.

title: Shotgun proteomics sample processing automated by an open-source lab robot (standard digestion scripts)
protocol_category: proteomics digestion, SP3 cleanup, BCA assay
results_evidence: Peptide identifications/CVs for automated vs manual digestion reported in the JoVE article.
readiness_reason: Already represented by shotgun-proteomics-jove; MIT scripts are usable but the JoVE text is not open.

title: Opentrons OT-2 Automated Protein Expression and Purification Guide (APEX companion repo)
protocol_category: protein expression and purification
results_evidence: APEX validated by expressing and purifying proteins with yields reported in the paper.
readiness_reason: Duplicate of the existing apex source; note that the journal version (ACS Synth Biol 2025) is newer than the bioRxiv entry on file.

title: Modification of a low-cost pipetting robot for nanoliter liquid handling and autosampling for LC-MS
protocol_category: nanoliter autosampling for LC-MS
results_evidence: Injection precision and chromatographic performance measured for the modified robot.
readiness_reason: Already tracked as pipetting-robot-nanoliter; control software is not an Opentrons protocol.

title: Opentrons for automated and high-throughput viscometry (supplementary protocol files)
code_files: (protocol files for proxy viscometer; see also beatricesoh/OTProxyViscometer)
protocol_category: viscosity measurement by timed aspiration
results_evidence: Measured viscosities correlated with reference rheometer values.
readiness_reason: Duplicate of proxy-viscometer; a second mirror repo (beatricesoh/OTProxyViscometer) exists with the same content.

title: UC2 Opentrons imaging unit / automated immunostaining (OT-2 + UC2 microscope)
protocol_category: automated immunostaining with in-situ imaging
results_evidence: Immunostained plates imaged on the UC2 microscope with staining quality shown in the protocol record.
readiness_reason: Already covered by uc2-hi2; the protocols.io immunostaining entry is a CC BY NL source that could still be paired with the control script.

title: BiomationScripter: Python library for scripting bio-automation protocols
code_files: BiomationScripter/OTProto/*.py (20 Opentrons-aware files incl. labware test protocols)
protocol_category: protocol-generation library (templates for PCR, dilution, transformation)
results_evidence: No wet-lab results tied to a publication found.
readiness_reason: MIT library whose OTProto templates could seed tasks, but no paper and protocols are generated rather than literal scripts.

title: DTU Synbio lab automation protocol collection
protocol_category: teaching/library protocols (agar plating, liquid-class optimisation, parameterised transfers)
results_evidence: No published results; teaching and internal-use repository.
readiness_reason: MIT and clean enough to simulate, and useful as extra solution exemplars, but no paper so it is not a triple.

title: DAMP Lab OT-2 diagnostic assay scripts (bead-based RNA extraction + multiplex RT-qPCR setup)
protocol_category: magnetic-bead nucleic acid extraction, qPCR plate setup
results_evidence: No peer-reviewed results in the repo; kit instructions are the reference.
readiness_reason: Two complete scripts in a protocol family already represented by covid19clinic/hulp sources, but no paper and no licence.

title: Newcastle Network Ecology Group OT-2 protocol and labware collection
code_files: Protocols/*.py (51 Opentrons-aware files; mix of API v1 and v2)
protocol_category: mixed lab protocols and custom labware definitions
results_evidence: No linked publication found.
readiness_reason: No paper, unlicensed, and many scripts are API v1 labware tests.

title: Endy Lab Opentrons protocol collection
protocol_category: PCR setup, dilution series, calibration
results_evidence: No linked publication.
readiness_reason: Mostly legacy API v1, no paper, no licence.

title: XChem Opentrons reaction liquid-handling toolkit
venue: repository only (XChem crystallography pipeline papers do not release these scripts)
code_files: examples/**/*.py (60 Opentrons-aware files, API v1 era)
protocol_category: reaction dispensing arrays for crystallographic screening
results_evidence: No single paper ties these scripts to reported results.
readiness_reason: Apache-2.0 but API v1 generated scripts and no paper pairing.

title: Pozzo group OT-2 design-of-experiments protocols
venue: repository only (group has related SDL papers)
protocol_category: formulation DoE sample preparation
results_evidence: Results appear in separate group publications, not this repo.
readiness_reason: MIT and simulatable, but the paper pairing must be established before it is a triple.

title: myrPlate engineered connective tissue casting on Opentrons Flex
protocol_category: collagen/cell suspension casting into 48-well tissue plates
results_evidence: README describes casting engineered connective tissues; no publication located.
readiness_reason: MIT Flex scripts with viscous cell-laden gel handling (valuable hard task) but no paper yet.

title: Opentrons Flex whole-genome / methylation / TIP-seq workflows (di-omics)
protocol_category: NGS library prep on Flex with off-deck handoffs
results_evidence: README tracks validation status per protocol but no publication.
readiness_reason: Rich Flex protocol set with explicit validation status, but unlicensed and unpublished.

title: Opentrons OT-2 mass-balance integration (application note supplement)
protocol_category: gravimetric calibration with external balance
results_evidence: Gravimetric accuracy of dispensed volumes reported in the application note.
readiness_reason: Notebook-only, external-hardware dependent, no peer-reviewed paper.

title: OT-2 10x scRNA-seq library prep with multiplexing (Retro Biosciences)
protocol_category: single-cell library prep with magnetic bead steps
results_evidence: README warns the protocol is difficult to run reliably; no published results.
readiness_reason: No paper, no licence, and the authors flag reliability problems.

title: Automated magnetic bead-based digestion protocols for Opentrons OT-2 (proteomics CNB-CBM)
protocol_category: SP3 bead digestion
results_evidence: None published.
readiness_reason: No Python protocol files present despite the MIT licence and OT-2 framing.

title: C. elegans food preference protocol (bacteria and worm spotting on OT-2)
venue: repository (protocol adapted from J Exp Biol 2006)
protocol_category: spotting bacteria and worms onto agar plates
results_evidence: Protocol reproduces a published behavioural assay; no new results in the repo.
readiness_reason: GPL-3.0 and two tidy scripts; the referenced paper predates the automation, so the triple is weak.

title: Automated cloning by natural transformation (ANT) OT-2 workflow
protocol_category: PCR, digestion, overlap-extension PCR, natural transformation, plating
results_evidence: Cloning efficiency and correct-assembly rates for automated natural transformation reported in the paper.
readiness_reason: Five numbered end-to-end scripts explicitly tied to a named publication; repo unlicensed and the ACS text may need an author copy.

title: Opentrons/PhysicalAI (Hugging Face dataset of Flex teleoperation episodes)
code_files: (HDF5 episodes + GIFs, e.g. flex_to_biotek/inference/*.hdf5; no protocol .py)
protocol_category: Flex plate-handoff manipulation episodes (imitation learning data)
results_evidence: Inference session summaries record on-robot execution of plate handoffs to a BioTek reader.
readiness_reason: No protocol code or paper; relevant as embodiment data rather than a paper->code task, and the licence is unstated.
